{"reason": "6 of 8 false arbitrations have confidence < 0.7 (0.44-0.67) yet v1 arbitrates; the provided high-confidence? helper is unused. Adding it as a gate should cut FAR (0.714) sharply, keeping recall high and satisfying the recall>=0.8 gate.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
